submissions.decision-railway-junction-removal: WITH RECURSIVE junctions(j) AS (SELECT end_a FROM tracks UNION SELECT end_b FROM tracks), edges(src, dst) AS (SELECT end_a, end_b FROM tracks UNION ALL SELECT end_b, end_a FROM tracks), reachable(removed, start, node) AS (SELECT r.j, s.j, s.j FROM junctions AS r CROSS JOIN junctions AS s WHERE s.j <> r.j UNION SELECT p.removed, p.start, e.dst FROM reachable AS p JOIN edges AS e ON e.src = p.node WHERE e.dst <> p.removed), labels AS (SELECT removed, start, MIN(node COLLATE BINARY) AS representative FROM reachable GROUP BY removed, start) SELECT removed AS junction, COUNT(DISTINCT representative) AS components FROM labels GROUP BY removed HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT representative) >= 2 ORDER BY junction COLLATE BINARY
submissions.decision-ration-sealed-refill-packs: WITH counts(n) AS (VALUES (0),(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6)), choices AS (SELECT x.n * a.pack_units AS units_a, y.n * b.pack_units AS units_b, a.need_units AS need_a, b.need_units AS need_b, r.free_units, r.note_id AS release_note, a.slip_id AS slip_a, b.slip_id AS slip_b FROM bay_slip AS a CROSS JOIN bay_slip AS b CROSS JOIN stock_release AS r CROSS JOIN counts AS x CROSS JOIN counts AS y WHERE a.bay_id = 'A' AND b.bay_id = 'B') SELECT units_a, units_b, release_note, slip_a, slip_b FROM choices WHERE units_a <= need_a AND units_b <= need_b AND units_a + units_b <= free_units ORDER BY MIN(units_a * need_b, units_b * need_a) DESC, units_a + units_b DESC, units_a DESC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-ration-swap-pack-charging: WITH RECURSIVE subsets(mask, last_bit, energy, trips) AS (SELECT 0, 0, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT s.mask + p.pack_bit, p.pack_bit, s.energy + p.need_kwh, s.trips + p.trip_count FROM subsets AS s JOIN pack_job AS p ON p.pack_bit > s.last_bit), winner AS (SELECT s.mask, n.source_id FROM subsets AS s CROSS JOIN shift_notice AS n WHERE s.energy <= n.allot_kwh ORDER BY s.trips DESC, s.energy ASC, s.mask ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT w.source_id, p.pack_name, p.need_kwh, p.trip_count FROM winner AS w JOIN pack_job AS p ON (w.mask & p.pack_bit) <> 0 ORDER BY p.pack_bit
submissions.decision-rebalance-chilled-trailer-bays: WITH masks(blue_mask) AS (VALUES (0),(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6),(7)), placements AS (SELECT m.blue_mask, l.pallets, l.initial_bay, CASE WHEN (m.blue_mask & l.lot_bit) <> 0 THEN 'blue' ELSE 'gold' END AS final_bay FROM masks AS m CROSS JOIN lot_manifest AS l), totals AS (SELECT blue_mask, SUM(CASE WHEN final_bay = 'blue' THEN pallets ELSE 0 END) AS blue_pallets, SUM(CASE WHEN final_bay = 'gold' THEN pallets ELSE 0 END) AS gold_pallets, SUM(CASE WHEN final_bay <> initial_bay THEN pallets ELSE 0 END) AS handled_pallets FROM placements GROUP BY blue_mask) SELECT blue_mask, blue_pallets, gold_pallets, handled_pallets FROM totals CROSS JOIN bay_limits WHERE blue_pallets <= blue_cap AND gold_pallets <= gold_cap ORDER BY handled_pallets, blue_mask LIMIT 1
